title: Rhino Panel Verification Schema
description: Schema for rhino-panel-verification evidence files. Records the results of panel registration, open, and visibility checks.

commit.description: Git commit SHA of the tested code (testedCommit).

platform.description: Platform on which the verification was performed.

rhinoVersion.description: Rhino version detected (e.g., "8.30"). Null if Rhino not found.

panelRegistered.description: Whether panel registration succeeded. "BLOCKED" if verification was blocked.

panelOpened.description: Whether panel was opened successfully. "BLOCKED" if verification was blocked.

panelVisible.description: Whether panel is visible in Rhino's panel container. "BLOCKED" if verification was blocked. May be false in headless CI.

rhpInstalled.description: Whether the .rhp file was found in the Rhino plugins directory.

pluginLoadResult.description: Result of plugin load: "SUCCESS", "BLOCKED", or error detail.

settingsFileExists.description: Whether the user settings file was found after first save.

logFileExists.description: Whether the runtime log file was created.

macOSAccessibilityGranted.description: macOS-specific: whether Accessibility permissions were granted for automation.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about the verification run.

blocker.description: If finalStatus is BLOCKED, describes the blocker.
